about: Hand corrections of the neighbours' station lists (RUNBOOK 3.23b). scripts/region_map.py applies them every time it writes content/com/local/<cc>/stanice.json: remove (dup_of = the record that keeps the site), patch (set = fields, src = sources added), add (station). A correction whose station is gone prints a warning, never an error.
